Identify entities: Elric of Melniboné (character), Michael Moorcock (creator), series of sword and sorcery stories (maybe work), alternative Earth (setting), title: Elric VIII, 428th Emperor of Melniboné (title), Eternal Champion (concept).

Relations: "fictional character created by" => creator. So subject: Elric of Melniboné, relation: "creator", object: Michael Moorcock. subject_type: "fictional character". object_type: "human" (author).

"protagonist of" => series of sword and sorcery stories. So relation: "protagonist of". object: "series of sword and sorcery stories". Could be "Elric saga" but not named. We'll use "sword and sorcery stories". subject_type: fictional character, object_type: "literary work series".

"takes place on" => alternative Earth. So relation: "setting". object: "alternative Earth". subject_type: "literary work series"? Actually the stories take place on alternative Earth. "The proper name and title of the character is Elric VIII, 428th Emperor of Melniboné." So relation: "title" or "has title". Subject: Elric of Melniboné, relation: "title", object: "Elric VIII, 428th Emperor of Melniboné". subject_type: fictional character, object_type: "title".

"Later stories by Moorcock marked Elric as a facet of the Eternal Champion." So relation: "facet of" maybe "instance of" or "aspect of". We'll use "facet of". Subject: Elric of Melniboné, relation: "facet of", object: "Eternal Champion". subject_type: fictional character, object_type: "fictional concept".

Also "created by Michael Moorcock" maybe also "author of" relation from Michael Moorcock to the series. But we focus on main.
